reason: Ten distinct headline/article research decisions; four traceable raw ideas plus two properly-held unverified news items.

articles.reason: Chinese support package for methanol/electric vessel construction appears in a syndicated headline; original government measure, subsidy scope and applicable parties not independently read. Hold rather than assert a product delta.
BTHaber original article read; cloud overspend due to overprovisioning, contract commitments and lock-in yields a reviewable procurement workflow.

opportunities.core_job: Document financial and exit risks of cloud capacity and long-term commitments before contract approval
opportunities.target_customer: Turkish SME IT leads, cloud resellers and procurement officers
opportunities.product_mechanism: User-entered workloads, resource overprovisioning, contract terms, reservation length, budget and exit rights; what-if scenario and accountable approval report without cloud billing APIs
opportunities.why_now: BTHaber 13 October details cloud spend inflation caused by excess allocated resources, lengthy commitments and technology lock-in.
opportunities.before_state: Cloud budgets approved by monthly bill without decision trail for reserved capacity and lock-in.
opportunities.after_state: Cost and exit decision matrix with alternatives, human signoff and auditable evidence.
opportunities.zero_cost_hypothesis: Manual datasets and browser-only deterministic calculations; competition and cost claims not final

articles.reason: Reuters confirms Microsoft Maia chip rollout, but is primarily a vendor hardware roadmap; no new low-cost third-party buyer workflow separable from existing accelerator deployment planning.
Chinese industry commentary about models generating interfaces has no discrete regulation, customer process change or demonstrated unmet buyer problem.
Corporate profit forecast (StarFive semiconductor) is securities disclosure; no repeatable B2B workflow.
Robotics training/feed ecosystem headline could imply data consent or QA workflow, but source text and precise operational delta not independently established.
Quollio original announcement describes a cross-team semantics/ontology and AI-context-governance integration change.

opportunities.idea_name: Enterprise AI Context Asset Signoff Register
opportunities.core_job: Sign off taxonomy, knowledge graph and controlled context assets before wider AI-agent reuse
opportunities.target_customer: Enterprise data stewards and AI platform governance leads
opportunities.product_mechanism: CSV/manual taxonomy, entity lineage, allowed use, owner review, semantic version delta and agent use approval matrix, with no runtime AI service
opportunities.why_now: Quollio's 8 October notice says CTC started distributing Quollio Data Intelligence Cloud/INTEGRAL to coordinate metadata/taxonomy/ontology assets across enterprise AI agents.
opportunities.before_state: Context assets and approvals are held across different corporate teams and tools.
opportunities.after_state: Portable semantic-asset inventory and change approval record before deployment.
opportunities.zero_cost_hypothesis: Manual datasets and browser-only deterministic calculations; competition and cost claims not final

articles.reason: Machine Design article details line losses from adhesive part presentation and feed handling, suitable for deterministic pilot evidence.

opportunities.core_job: Assess whether component presentation and feed mode causes line cycle delays before capital equipment changes
opportunities.target_customer: Manufacturing assembly engineers and flexible-label/seal handling suppliers
opportunities.product_mechanism: Manual component type, liner/peel mode, handling time, line takt, reject and trial evidence CSV; deterministic bottleneck comparison and signoff
opportunities.why_now: Machine Design 13 October outlines assembly productivity losses from inadequate feeding/presentation of adhesive flexible parts despite faster robots.
opportunities.before_state: Material/shape choices optimized independently from line-feed throughput.
opportunities.after_state: Repeatable component feeding pilot acceptance record and throughput sensitivity report.
opportunities.zero_cost_hypothesis: Manual datasets and browser-only deterministic calculations; competition and cost claims not final

YourStory original profile describes TRL5 methane plasma pyrolysis producing both hydrogen and carbon black; measurable pilot economics.

opportunities.core_job: Reconcile methane input and energy with hydrogen and carbon black output during pilot-scale commercialization
opportunities.target_customer: Methane pyrolysis developers, refinery energy transition teams and H2 project financiers
opportunities.product_mechanism: User-supplied methane feed, energy, H2 and solid carbon output, carbon-grade price, trial conditions and cost entries; material-balance and TCO/uncertainty comparison
opportunities.why_now: YourStory 13 October reports Hypersonic Technologies TRL5 staged-plasma pilot producing hydrogen and carbon black; commercialization depends on proving dual-product yield economics.
opportunities.before_state: Hydrogen/coproduct economics and test evidence tracked on separate, unversioned spreadsheets.
opportunities.after_state: A versioned transparent yields, coproduct revenue and trial-cost case approved by engineer.
opportunities.zero_cost_hypothesis: Manual datasets and browser-only deterministic calculations; competition and cost claims not final
